note: Failures the app has today that the commit adding the case does not fix. Each prints on every run and does not fail the run. A known failure that starts passing DOES fail the run, so a fix is never merged without its entry coming off this list. An entry matches a case id exactly through `case`, or by a regular expression through `match` when one finding shows up under several case ids.

failures.shows: Help sends every question to POST /api/agent/message and waits for the whole answer
failures.why: The streaming route Step 111 shipped is not asked yet. The next commit sends every question there, with the same body, query and headers

failures.shows: Nothing appears where the answer goes until the whole answer is in, 4.8 seconds after Send on the stub's twelve pieces 400 ms apart
failures.why: The answer is read whole, through apiFetch's r.json(). The next commit reads it as it is written

failures.shows: No answer is on screen part way through, so there are no plain words to read while it arrives
failures.why: The page has no answer that is still arriving. The next commit draws one, without its formatting marks

failures.shows: The page never reads a reset, since it never reads the stream
failures.why: The next commit reads the stream, and a reset takes back what was drawn since meta or the last reset

failures.shows: The whole answer is handled key by key, from the route that answers whole
failures.why: The same handling moves to the stream's done in the next commit, key for key

failures.shows: A refusal of the streaming route never reaches the page, which asks the other route
failures.why: The next commit asks the streaming route and shows its JSON refusal the way a refusal has always been shown

failures.shows: An error event never reaches the page, which asks the other route
failures.why: The next commit shows an error event the way a refusal with the same status has always been shown

failures.shows: A connection that drops part way through an answer reads Not sent, with the browser's words and Retry, though the API stored the answer
failures.why: The next commit keeps meta's conversation id and reads the stored answer back from the conversation

failures.shows: There is no Try again for an answer that is not stored yet. Retry asks the question a second time
failures.why: The next commit offers Try again, which reads the conversation back again

failures.shows: The Help page has no live region, so a screen reader hears nothing when the answer comes
failures.why: The next commit adds one live region, which says the finished answer once
